description.value: Elysium Korean Bistro & Restaurant is a Korean cuisine establishment located in Richmond's Alexandra Road commercial corridor. It operates out of a unit in what appears to be a multi-tenant commercial building. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's busy food district may find it a convenient stop for a Korean meal.

No phone number is present in OSM, and no corroborating details are available to confirm any cyclist-relevant amenities.
